entries.objective: Understand basic cybersecurity concepts, why security matters, and common security career paths.
Distinguish security practices for individuals vs. companies and what each should do differently.
Identify common attackers, attack types, and the consequences a successful or failed attack can have.
Explain the need for defensive measures online and describe practical steps to stay safe.
Explain why cryptography matters and apply basic cryptographic algorithms.
Explain the importance of Linux in cybersecurity and run basic Linux commands.
Describe additional categories of cyberattacks and the specifics of how they work.
Describe the learner's own role in keeping themselves and others safe online.
Explain penetration testing types and concepts, and identify authorized environments to practice hacking.
Apply core networking concepts to deepen understanding of security fundamentals.
Explain cloud security fundamentals including common threats, shared responsibility, and best practices.

entries.objective: Run pwd, whoami, and ls -la, then summarise directory ownership/permissions in report.txt.
Identify the local nginx service and capture response headers including X-Powered-By and X-Application in recon-notes.txt.
Rank offending IPs from a failed-auth log and record findings plus an incident summary in findings.txt.
Trace privilege escalation from an SSH session to root and record the user, timestamp, and method in priv-esc-report.txt.
Correlate SSH, HTTP, and syslog events into a chronological, deduplicated timeline of at least 8 entries.
Detect periodic callback patterns in an HTTP access log by analysing user-agent strings and request intervals.
